# Cafe Kokomo

> A cozy neighbourhood cafe in Santacruz East, Mumbai, serving specialty coffee, matcha, all-day breakfast, hummus, pasta, sandwiches and desserts. Open daily 11 AM to 11 PM. Opened in October 2021.

## Visit
- Address: 4, Pratap CHS Limited, Shivaji Road, near Vakola Bridge, Santacruz East, Mumbai, Maharashtra 400055, India
- Hours: every day, 11:00 AM to 11:00 PM (IST)
- Phone: +91 85915 15657, +91 88794 40033
- WhatsApp (table bookings): +91 85915 15657
- Email: info@cafekokomo.com
- Directions: https://www.google.com/maps/dir/?api=1&destination=Cafe+Kokomo,+Santacruz+East,+Mumbai
- Average cost for two: about ₹400 to ₹600

## Menu
- Full dine-in menu with prices: https://cafekokomo.com/menu (128 items; vegetarian, egg and non-vegetarian items are marked)
- Sections: hot and iced coffee, signature drinks, matcha, hot chocolate and frappes, milkshakes, teas and coolers, all-day breakfast, croissants, hummus, fries and small plates, chicken bites, pasta, sandwiches and panini, salads and bowls, desserts and pancakes
- Most ordered (Aug to Oct 2026): The Classic Cold Coffee, Cappuccino, Alfredo Pasta, Americano, Seasoned Fries, Pink Sauce Pasta, Iced Americano, Iced Hazelnut Latte
- Price range: coffee from ₹149 (espresso); most mains ₹299 to ₹399

## Order online
- Zomato: https://www.zomato.com/mumbai/cafe-kokomo-santacruz-east/order

## Good to know
- Work friendly: Wi-Fi and power plugs
- Payment: cash, card or UPI
- 103 of 128 menu items are vegetarian; one dessert (World's Best Chocolate Cake) is marked gluten-free
- Table reservations through the website form, which sends a WhatsApp message to the cafe
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cafekokomo
